name: weekly-connection-pool-health
description: Weekly HikariCP connection pool health report — utilisation, wait times, and leak detection.
prompt: Query Spring Actuator metrics for HikariCP: connection pool size, active connections, pending threads, connection timeout count, leaked connection count. Check pool utilisation trend over last 7 days. Alert if utilisation > 80% or leaked connections > 0. Generate weekly pool health report.
